courses.seoDescription: Spanish-language training in New York including OSHA, SST, scaffold, flagger, silica, electrical, plumbing, blueprint reading and other workforce courses.

hero.title: Training for safer, better-prepared work
hero.copy: AEINY and Centro Comunitario Andino provide training built around the real needs of immigrant workers, including construction safety, scaffold training, skilled trades and practical workforce development.
hero.imageAlt: Participants attend a construction safety training session.

catalog.title: Training programs
catalog.copy: Explore programs currently promoted by AEINY. Dates, prices and delivery formats may change, so confirm current details directly with the center before registering.
catalog.noResults: No courses match your search. Try another term or category.

why.title: Training built for working communities
why.copy: Programs combine safety education, workforce preparation and technical skills with an accessible approach for New York's Spanish-speaking community.

formats.title: Formats & enrollment information
formats.copy: Course formats may vary by program. Contact AEINY to confirm current availability, delivery format, dates, fees, location and requirements before registering.

availability.question: Are courses currently open for enrollment?
availability.answer: Courses are organized on different dates throughout the year. Contact AEINY to confirm the next class, schedule, format and availability.

prices.question: Are prices and schedules fixed?
prices.answer: Prices, discounts and promotions may vary by program. Contact AEINY directly for current pricing before registering.

credentials.question: Does completing a course guarantee a card, certification or license?
credentials.answer: Some programs relate to cards or safety requirements for construction work. Credential types and requirements depend on the course and each worker's situation; confirm details with AEINY before enrolling.

inquiry.title: Need current course information?
inquiry.copy: Contact AEINY to ask about course availability, format, dates, fees and enrollment requirements.
inquiry.copyWithCourse: Contact AEINY to ask about current availability and details for {{course}}.

detail.upcomingCopy: Class dates and schedules vary. Contact AEINY to ask about the next available class and confirm current requirements.
